implementation.scope: Preserves entire MathML base, source spacing, nested hats, and neighboring scripts.
implementation.font_variants: Authentic full-base bold and bold-italic styles become mathbf and native mathbfit, including transparent mstyle/mrow wrappers. Explicitly styled Greek bases retain their source Unicode glyph because MathJax Greek command macros override surrounding font commands. Rendered bold-italic beta is verified as bold-italic MathML and glyph U+1D737.
implementation.unsupported_cues: Operator-only styles/sizing, explicit accent=false, unrecognized stretchy values, and unsupported partial/nested font variants produce explicit Unsupported MathML hat review gaps instead of silently discarding source cues. Existing source color serialization in question_capture remains scoped.
implementation.unchanged: Ordinary movers, operator limits, scripts, and the brace repair retain their behavior.
